notes.title: Espresso Tycoon – full version - NOW ON STEAM!
notes.content:
Dear Coffee Lovers, 

[b]The day has come![/b]

[h3]The full version of Espresso Tycoon is now available for all of you to play on Steam![/h3]

We listened carefully to the voice of our community. We took into account the suggestions made in the demo and playtests and improved the game based on that. We also asked for opinions on several key issues, such as the choice of locations for the Prologue or the addition of new languages. We are very grateful for such a strongly involved community!

[b]We wouldn't be here without you![/b]

We hope the game will meet your expectations! We look forward to your feedback. 😄
[previewyoutube=IZjz7fwTL2c;full][/previewyoutube]

Earlier we announced that on the day of release, we will give you cheat codes for unlocking all the locations in the Sandbox. However, we decided that we will unlock them by default 😄 Enjoy!

Your Coffee Enthusiasts,
DreamWay Games Team

notes.title: Espresso Tycoon Prologue: Underwater - PATCH #4
notes.content:
Dear Coffee Lovers,

As you know, we are getting ready to release the full version of [b]Espresso Tycoon[/b] (which is coming to Steam on the 7th of June!). But before that, we wanted to give you a new opportunity in the Prologue. 😄

We are adding a new feature - [b]Resolution Quality[/b].

In the game settings, you can use the slider to efficiently change the[b] resolution of the game[/b].

Here's how to use it:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/5878460ff026dc7607a3218d2d4e070abc430dc5.gif[/img]

Here you can compare the difference:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/cdee5245dfbc004dbfda3a4876e2f8f013282d2e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/e500f1f0a25e68603cebbec19a2e808db2f07a94.png[/img]

This is a feature that will be especially useful for those who play on low-end hardware.

You will notice that it affects the quality of the graphics, but you will be able to freely adjust it to match the capabilities of your computer using the slider.

We hope that this will make the game run smoothly for you. 😄

Let us know your thoughts!

And remember - the full version of [b]Espresso Tycoon is coming to Steam on the 7th of June[/b]! Don't forget to add to your Wishlist ːsteamhappyː

Your Coffee Enthusiasts,
DreamWay Games Team

notes.title: Check out ALL the locations!
notes.content:
Dear Coffee Lovers,

As you already know, we're preparing 10 different locations (and missions) for you in Espresso Tycoon. You already know two of them - Sydney, the underwater one, and London, where our Tutorial is located. 

It's time to present what we're preparing for you!

[b]1. Cape Town[/b]
You can already know that location from our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1543280/Espresso_Tycoon/]short demo of the full version of Espresso Tycoon[/url]. You start your journey here. This is a great place to run a coffee truck and an outdoor cafe!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/9e57f642e76916b884179efa32ddf8fdb9f67cba.png[/img]

[b]2. New York[/b]
Run your coffee shop in a city that never sleeps and has a lot of coffee shops where you can spend time with your... Friends 😉
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/af9aa32f2f01d07e351ec068b046a6ef28521641.png[/img]

[b]3. São Paulo[/b]
Take care of the customers who are always in a rush - because you're running a coffee shop in a subway station 🚇
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/3f64012dfeb2f9b8ca0fc52498cec15f0b30c744.jpg[/img]

[b]4. Paris[/b]
Enjoy the beautiful surroundings and exquisite flavors. Conquer the capital of fashion - with your coffee shop in Paris 🥐
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/78676f875eea26d6b3b2cc930d29e77eeb24d315.png[/img]

[b]5. Siberia[/b]
Take a long train trip. A very long one! Don't forget to serve your customers a good cup of coffee - it will be useful for them not to get cold 🚆
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/d5f2b464278b5b5dc75404a7b378c0fe57b297b4.png[/img]

[b]6. London[/b]
You can already know that location from our first demo and the tutorial added to our Prologue. Improve your management skills and be careful - some say you may get robbed there!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/206dabc8b8368624e8c1515383509febd02c2392.png[/img]

[b]7. Mexico City[/b]
Who wouldn't want to relax in a five-star hotel with a good cup of coffee? Take care of your customers who want to enjoy a relaxing stay here. They also want to enjoy some pieces of art! Do you think you'll be able to bring the 'Mona Lisa' here?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/c34fde6ebaede884f22089388985a4e8e05df6ed.png[/img]
[b]
8. Sydney[/b]
That location is pretty popular. You've chosen the underwater coffee shop as our Prologue's location. Run a successful coffee business and take care of the sea creatures (and customers, too, of course)!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/311894edb8ac63608fc2ea783eb4029741ebfa15.jpg[/img]

[b]9. Los Angeles[/b]
To get to Hollywood - this is the dream of many. And you will be able to run your cafe there! Beach, palm trees, ocean, and good coffee - it's a match!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/1d7512b429685754a04f589353767d90cb2a186c.png[/img]

[b]10. Tokyo[/b]
Last but not least! Tokyo is still the world's largest city in terms of population, so you can expect to need a lot of coffee there... Will you manage to take care of so many customers?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/6b357b290449dde956af8dbd3c341e8e57ef609c.png[/img]

[h3][b]Which one do you like the most? [/b][/h3]ːsteamhappyː

[b]P.S. How did you name your underwater coffee shop in our Prologue?[/b] ːsteamhappyː
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1904980/Espresso_Tycoon_Prologue_Underwater/

notes.title: Animals in Espresso Tycoon - add YOUR PET to the full version of the game!
notes.content:
Dear Coffee Lovers,

Yes, that's true!
[b][h3]
Your pet can appear in our Espresso Tycoon!
[/h3][/b]
But... let's start from the beginning. Coffee is our hero in [b]Espresso Tycoon[/b], you know that. But we don't forget about our four-legged loved ones!
That's why... we're adding some animals to our game!

In the full version of the game we will have cats:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/90e25d4c746a19f8a14527c2c01059cd945b9552.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/83f8873ccecb3d0b3f152a833b953c22b25e57a6.png[/img]

We have dogs:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/32358e596703ec37809266d77e2ecc88a29d8b49.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/65ce2110f3e63c509ad7dd71d72dd5d0bc541397.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/3f2dc50a6f8282ae6a3865d3a8fcb4552994789e.png[/img]


And some more animals, like flamingos, pigeons, ducks, or swans!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/5d57a8753e54ca11cecef0a5ae576e19f32c4a4f.png[/img]

There will be also some sea creatures which you can already know from our Prologue.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/0e7297af079bbdc3649163984f258d063e576a48.gif[/img]

And here's the BIG NEWS!

[b][h3]We can add your pet to Espresso Tycoon![/h3][/b]

Send the picture of your pet to media@dreamwaygames.com.

Our jury will decide which [b]3 of them[/b] will appear in our game. 

Just like the dog Halinka here:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/4cfbae615b80d6ee5f43d08da0d87a2554191987.png[/img]

We will also add one special screenshot on our Steam page with all the winning pictures presented in the game.
We will make a special announcement with ALL the pets you sent to us!

Here are some rules:
1. You're sending a picture (max 3 different pictures) to us via: media@dreamwaygames.com.
2. By sending the picture you're admitting that you are the owner of that image and you have all the copyrights needed (in a nutshell - you admit that you're the author of that picture).
3. By sending the picture to us you allow us to use these images in the game for free and agree to publish them on steam and on our social media. 
4. It may be obvious, but we have to say this - you can't send us drastic or obscene photos.
5, By taking part in the contest you're agreeing with its [url=https://dreamwaygames.com/contest-rules/]Rules[/url].

You can send us these pictures by January 31st!

notes.title: Espresso Tycoon - NEW LANGUAGES to the full version of the game!
notes.content:
Dear Coffee Lovers!

Do you remember our voting for languages that you want to be added to the full version of Espresso Tycoon?

[h3]YOU CHOSE!
[/h3]
We're going to add [b]Japanese, Italian, and Korean[/b]!

We remind you that [b]English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Russian, German, Chinese (Simplified), and Polish[/b] are already in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/972655c2dd4e860a67f5a73d830fe4edfdda6e3e.png[/img]

[h2]I voted for my language and it's not on the list - why?[/h2]

- As we wrote before, languages in our voting with at least 100 votes will be added to the game. Japanese, Korean, and Italian fulfilled these requirements. There's a chance that other languages will be added in the future - but it's too soon to decide.

[h2]Can I help with the translation to my language?
[/h2]
- SURE! We can do the community translation with you - if you would like to add your language to the game and help us with that! Join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/D8ht5td - we will give you more details there.

And remember - we're going to release [b]Espresso Tycoon[/b] in Spring 2023! 

[b][h3]It's going to be so much fun![/h3][/b]

notes.title: RELEASE DATE REVEAL- 4th of November!
notes.content:
Dear Coffee Lovers,

[h3]We are more than happy to announce that we're going to release our [b]Espresso Tycoon Prologue: Underwater[/b] on the 4th of November 2022![/h3]

We have a new gameplay video:
[previewyoutube=p-mKPJ_hNHQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We can say that we've made very big progress since the demo version of [b]Espresso Tycoon[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/b4a9d419d8af865e1e96485b522a95931a34fa29.png[/img]

Thanks to having the players' feedback we were able to fulfill our goals from the roadmap, fix a lot of bugs and add a bunch of new features.

Here are a few of them:

- a possibility to have more than one barista working at the same time

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/c3f4959d57a615506d5e27178e9ec2802706b16f.png[/img]

- skipping time to the next day

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/232f78758379033d60f455f05efb4fe500405d2e.png[/img]

- new decoration items

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/61e48c9e859a08589a0b0aa9b643eca8f38322d5.png[/img]

- a possibility of selling snacks 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/6761e06621f575ac1616d4f711d5df1ca7f2a905.png[/img]

- toppings in the coffee editor

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/871d655e5ce80f9270d118e945e3ce1ca767b74d.jpg[/img]

- profit and loss table

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/dd6549ae745874e36583c5676c136e8227fadb67.png[/img]

- different coffee machines

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/ed8b0aff3faaee6f7768691bb32c285649d22a53.png[/img]

- a possibility to save and load the game state

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/d472637c79853fa42a03590219e6da2036f554d2.png[/img]

To all the people who helped us with the beta testing: 
[h3]We wouldn't be here without you! Thank you so much! [/h3]

You chose the location - Underwater in Sydney!

That was a very interesting choice and it took a lot of work to make it real :)

We really hope that you'll like the game and be able to feel the mood that we've created!

P.S. The full version of Espresso Tycoon is coming in spring 2023!

Your Coffee Enthusiasts,
DreamWay Games Team

notes.title: Espresso Tycoon Prologue: Underwater is coming THIS OCTOBER!
notes.content:
Dear Coffee Lovers,

We are more than happy to announce that our[b] Espresso Tycoon Prologue: Underwater[/b] is coming [b]THIS OCTOBER![/b]

Here's the gameplay trailer:
[previewyoutube=bDRP51oRWaM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]WHY UNDERWATER (SYDNEY)?[/b][/h3]

YOU chose the location! In our voting that one got the most votesːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/64c3208d12942d847a984b8e519ee85bcd4b647d.jpg[/img]

[b]And we’re listening to your voice![/b]

The Prologue’s development has been shaped by the analysis of your feedback. During playtests and Steam Next Fest, our players filled out almost 1000 surveys. Armed with this feedback, we’ve fixed a lot of bugs, improved the camera movement, and the game balance, and - of course - added a bunch of [b]new features[/b]:

[list]
[*] a possibility to have more than one barista working at the same time
[*] skipping time to the next day
[*] new decoration items
[*] a possibility of selling snacks 
[*] toppings in the coffee editor
[*] profit and loss table
[*] different coffee machines
[*] a possibility to save and load the game state
[*] a brand new main menu screen
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/b0a2a8bf42c2396208d2fb26f3e3fd41db3afe3e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/54e09f4aa401420c3a326cd4a7f26e3ee3c25703.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/e5415ed5fdd3067b09fd1d7c64fd204ff98da750.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]SEA CREATURES[/b][/h3]

Of course, such a location requires unique and specific surroundings. Your customers will admire sharks, jellyfish, octopus, and sunken ships…The supplies will be delivered by submarines! (Drones wouldn’t fly here, right?)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/0e7297af079bbdc3649163984f258d063e576a48.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/e6eabe60282ee11d234c17e6b7ba347583ad6e37.png[/img]


And here’s the question:

[h3][b]How many sharks can you see in that announcement?[/b][/h3]
